'''Crista Arangala''' (née '''Crista Lynn Coles''') is an American mathematician and textbook author, specializing in [[numerical analysis]]. She is a professor of mathematics and chair of the department of mathematics and statistics at [[Elon University]],{{r|elon}} and a [[Fulbright Program|Fulbright Scholar]].

==Education==
Arangala graduated from [[Allegheny College]] in 1993.{{r|elon|kaldron}} She earned her Ph.D. in 2000 from the [[University of Cincinnati]], with a dissertation on ''Numerical Identification of Parameters in Inverse Heat Conduction and Inverse Euler Bernoulli Beam Theory'' supervised by Diego Antonio Murio.{{r|elon|mgp}}

==International work==
Arangala has regularly taken her Elon mathematics classes to India and Sri Lanka, where they have participated in elementary-school mathematics education.{{r|promo|hindu|pendulum}} In 2013–2014 she was a [[Fulbright Program|Fulbright Scholar]] in Sri Lanka.{{r|promo|fulbright}}
